versions.changelog:
patent-panorama-insights-report 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces the fourth and final stage of the patent panorama pipeline, generating a comprehensive, client-ready HTML insights report.
- Transforms structured outputs from previous stages—including statistics, value signals, tagging systems, and SaaS-tagged pools—into clear narratives on technology evolution and defensible value moats.
- Supports two operation modes: Mode A (direct SaaS-tagged pool, automated sections) and Mode B (full contract with rubric-reviewed patent packages).
- Outputs include a self-contained report.html and report_manifest.json, combining executive summaries, technology matrices, evolution routes, value analysis, and recommended patent packages.
- Clearly communicates data sources, methodology, evidence levels, and report limitations.
